failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Coordinator query at hop 2: 'Did Kamal Haasan appear in any films directed by K. Balachander, who also directed "Sundara Swapnagalu"?' This is formulated as a natural-language yes/no question rather than entity names or keyword phrases.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query hop 2 asks 'Did Kamal Haasan appear in any films directed by K. Balachander, who also directed "Sundara Swapnagalu"?' after summary_1 already confirmed 'K. Balachander directed "Sundara Swapnagalu" (1986), and Kamal Haasan starred in several films directed by K. Balachander'. Query hop 3 lists 'Sundara Swapnagalu, K. Balachander, Kamal Haasan, Punnagai Mannan, Aakali Rajyam, Sollathaan Ninaikkiren' - entities already retrieved. Both hop 2 and hop 3 retrieval events return substantially the same documents (Sollathaan Ninaikkiren, Sundara Swapnagalu, Aakali Rajyam, Punnagai Mannan appear in all three hops).

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Solver at hop 2 processes passage [3] 'Vayanadan Thamban' (directed by A. Vincent, not K. Balachander), passage [5] 'Thevar Magan' (directed by Bharathan, not K. Balachander), and passage [6] 'C. Rudhraiya' (about director C. Rudhraiya, not K. Balachander). None of these passages are relevant to verifying whether Kamal Haasan starred in a film directed by K.
